reviews.reason: The size diagnostic identifies RoleDataPolicyDraft, the private owner of one role data-policy edit/submission lifecycle. RoleDataPolicySection keys that owner by roleCode. Only locally edited fields and their revisions are retained; untouched fields follow the current server snapshot. Readiness requires a matching returned role_code and loaded model data, and mutation/submission gates check readiness and edit permission. Success publishes the saved snapshot and retires only submitted revisions so later edits survive. These concrete boundaries explain the cohesive owner; the previous claim that drafts lacked role/readiness guards is contradicted by current source, not a current product defect. Reassessed 2026-11-03: system_all is now a view-only scope; update/delete use narrower write-scope types. Fixed option lists filter by action before label/value projection; role-keyed readiness and saved-revision draft ownership remain.
